name_reason: Current '_stage_b' suffix is misleading. KB confirms spell 0x11/0x12/0x13 are three distinct buff spells -- 魔刃術 (AP boost) / 魔鎧術 (DP/defense boost) / 風行術 (speed boost) -- not three stages of one spell; the sibling 0x11 plate explicitly flagged this 'stage' interpretation as unverified. This function is spell 0x12 = 魔鎧術 and delegates to fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell (DP-boost worker), so 'dp_boost' is the accurate descriptor. Keeps the valid spell-id domain '12' (verified via dispatch table entry index 0x12 @ 0x51D49 = 0x51D01+0x48) and the fd2_cast_spell_ family prefix. Note: actual rename applied in Stage 2 (touches protos.h + all call sites / dispatch usage).
purpose: Spell dispatch wrapper for spell_id 0x12 (魔鎧術 / DP-defense boost): resets the AoE target counter, deducts caster MP, and delegates to the DP-boost worker.
logic_summary: 13-inst CHK(0x10) leaf wrapper (single basic block, no branches). Sets global data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx = 0, calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, 0x12) to charge MP via cost-table index 0x12, then calls fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell(caster, n_targets, target_id_array) which performs the actual DP buff + impact animation. Returns void. Structurally mirrors the 0x11 AP-boost wrapper (fd2_cast_spell_11_stage_a @ 0x226EA) and the 0x13 speed-boost wrapper, differing only in the delegate worker.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_12_stage_b(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed through to fd2_deduct_caster_mp (to charge MP) and to fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell (to identify the buffing unit).
params.reason: Accurate, matches the caster_unit_id role used in both delegate calls; no address residue.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of AoE targets; passed straight to fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell as the target count.
params.reason: Clear, matches the n_targets role; no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id array (one byte per target); cast to uint32 and passed to fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell.
params.reason: Accurate, matches the target_id_array role; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are the global AoE-counter reset, the MP deduction, and the delegated DP-boost cast.

comment_original_issue: Source had no comment block above this function (the preceding 0x11 wrapper carried the family note, but the 0x12 wrapper itself was undocumented). Added a parallel comment identifying it as the 魔鎧術 / DP-defense boost spell-0x12 wrapper, noting the cost-table-index-0x12 MP deduction and the shared DP-boost worker (item-use path + 破壞神 summon).
notes: Dispatch-table entry verified: 0x51D49 (=0x51D01+0x48, entry index 0x12) holds 2f280200 = 0x0002282f. DP-boost worker fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell @ 0x22866 is called from 3 sites (this wrapper, fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch item-use path @ 0x20EA8, fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast 破壞神 @ 0x28625). No direct callers (function is reached only via the dispatch table). Aside (outside this symbol's scope, not actioned): dispatch table entry 0x13 @ 0x51D4D reads 0x29660 which resolves to fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic rather than the source's fd2_cast_spell_13_stage_c -- a possible mapping mismatch to investigate for the 0x13 symbol, unrelated to 0x12.
